                    ### Question
                    The Purkinje cells of the cerebellum receive direct input from:

                    ### Options

opb. Neurons of deep cerebellar nuclei.
opc. Climbing fibers
opd. Mossy fibers.
ope. Pyramidal neurons of cerebral cortex.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Purkinje cells of the cerebellum receive direct input from neurons of deep cerebellar nuclei, climbing fibers, and mossy fibers. Neurons of deep cerebellar nuclei and climbing fibers synapse directly onto Purkinje cells, while mossy fibers synapse onto granule cells which then synapse onto Purkinje cells. Spinal neurons indirectly influence Purkinje cells via spinocerebellar tracts. Evidence supports the direct connections between these structures.
